title: PhysioNet 2018 Challenge: Sleep Arousal Detection PSG (Training)
description: This dataset contains 1,983 overnight polysomnographic recordings from patients monitored at the Massachusetts General Hospital sleep laboratory for suspected sleep disorders, mainly obstructive sleep apnea. It was assembled for the PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2018 on automatic detection of sleep arousals. The training set (994 subjects) includes expert annotations of sleep stages, respiratory events and arousals, and the test set (989 subjects) contains signals only. Recordings cover EEG, EOG, chin EMG, respiratory effort, airflow, SpO2 and ECG, sampled at 200 Hz.
methods_description: Overnight PSG was recorded at 200 Hz over 13 channels: 6 EEG in a referential mastoid montage, 1 EOG, 1 chin EMG, 3 respiratory channels (abdominal, chest, airflow), SaO2 (resampled to 200 Hz) and 1 ECG. Certified sleep technologists scored sleep stages in 30-second epochs following the AASM manual, and also scored respiratory events and arousals. The original WFDB files were converted to BIDS-EEG.
